summary.text: Munira Abdullahi is a Democratic state representative from Columbus who has represented Ohio House District 9 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit professional.

paragraphs.text: Abdullahi grew up in Columbus, graduated from Columbus Alternative High School and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and international relations from The Ohio State University.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, her campaign said her parents fled Somalia when she was three and that she attended Columbus City Schools.
She succeeded Bishara Addison in District 9 and defeated Brandy Seymour in the November 5, 2024 general election.
She is ranking member of the Development Committee and also serves on Finance and Workforce and Higher Education.
Bruce Euans is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
